rv.q: The cumulative effect of this production of Holmes’s tight adaptation is a fully engaging and richly constructed community of players.
The Group Rep revival isn’t without its pluses, but overall, it doesn’t do John Grisham the justice he deserves.

cn.t: Critics praise this production of John Grisham's legal thriller, highlighting Hudson Long's compelling performance as lawyer Jake Brigance and the strong central performances that bring the courtroom drama to life.
